title: That Scary Line
description:
Hyun-su stopped {name} in the hallway.

'Hey — remember what you said at the ramen table?'

'If you don't try, it definitely won't happen.'

'That line. Still in my head. When I want to quit studying.'

choices.text: "That line is still in mine too."
choices.result_text:
Hyun-su nodded. Both still going, still not there.

Something said in a late-night kitchen had become a shared anchor.
Having someone who keeps the same words — that was unexpected support.

choices.text: "You still keeping at it? The exams?"
choices.result_text:
'Obviously. If I don't, it definitely won't happen.' He echoed it back.

Had to laugh.
Two people chasing different things in the same building — holding each other's words.

title: Same Fork Again
description:
Similar situation. Again.

Checking numbers — push harder, or pull back?

At the halfway point, said: 'Have to bet bigger.'
The result of that choice is what brought this moment.

choices.text: That call was right. Same logic applies.
choices.result_text:
Less hand-trembling this time. Done it before.

Fear exists — but it's a familiar fear now.
Result unknown. That's always the answer until it isn't.

choices.text: Learned something that day. Different play this time.
choices.result_text:
Remembered what big bets felt like from the inside.
The wins and the waiting.

This approach was different. Growth — or overcorrection? Results will say.

title: People Who Cashed Out
description:
Word of people who got out fast.
Big trades. Crypto. Startup exits.

At the halfway point: 'This method is right. Hold.'

That conviction is being tested again.

choices.text: Still believe the method is right
choices.result_text:
Other people's speed isn't the benchmark.

The halfway decision built the current stance.
If the reasoning holds, the destination holds too.

choices.text: Shaken — what if this pace is too slow?
choices.result_text:
Rising and falling. Both are visible.

Being shaken is fine. Changing course while shaken is different from deciding to change course.
Still here. Still going.

title: If You Keep Going
description:
A quiet day.

Sang-chul's words surfaced:

'I just kept going. Eventually you start to see things.'

Thirty years. That's what the patience looked like.

choices.text: Hold onto that — get through today
choices.result_text:
Need to go further before anything comes into view.

Sang-chul kept going even when his son called to say he was dropping out.
He got through it. Something showed up.
Today was kept.

choices.text: His method might not be the right one for this
choices.result_text:
Endurance is a method. So is changing course.

Sang-chul's way isn't automatically {name}'s way.
Knowing that — that's actually what the conversation gave.

title: The Manager Remembered
description:
Manager called after hours.

'You mentioned that personal project of yours—'

{name} braced.

'Work's been sharper lately. Not sure if that's related, but.'

choices.text: "Trying to balance both. Glad it shows."
choices.result_text:
Manager nodded and let it go.

Being honest that day turned out to be a different kind of credibility.
Not permission — just someone who knew and respected it.

choices.text: "More focused lately, I think." Keep the personal project separate
choices.result_text:
Not false.

The honesty from that day left a residue — the manager sees {name} slightly differently now.
Not entirely sure if that's good yet.

title: This Time It Was Different
description:
Same restaurant.

Someone came in the door — someone from high school.
Eyes met.

Not the polished classmate from before. A different face. Looking at {name}.

choices.result_text:
'Oh — you! What have you been up to?'

Explained. The response wasn't hollow this time.
'Wow, seriously?' Eyes went wide.

Same restaurant. Something had changed.
For the first time — felt it as a fact, not an idea.

choices.text: Just nod — each to their own table
choices.result_text:
Small acknowledgment. Both sat down separately.

The last time, left before finishing. This time, ate everything.

That was the difference.
